executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: (1) Type mismatches between Priority and TaskPriority enums, (2) Incorrect type conversions (long to UUID/String), (3) Service method signature mismatches requiring additional userId parameter, (4) Missing methods in GlobalExceptionHandler and InMemoryTaskDataStore classes.

errors.message: Priority enum cannot be converted to TaskPriority (occurs 15 times across test methods)
errors.root_cause: Test code uses Priority enum but the application expects TaskPriority enum. This indicates a refactoring where the enum was renamed but tests were not updated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all occurrences of 'Priority' with 'TaskPriority' in TaskControllerTest.java, or add import statement: import com.myproject.models.dtos.TaskPriority;

errors.message: Type conversion error: long cannot be converted to UUID (occurs 12 times)
errors.root_cause: Task IDs were changed from long to UUID type but test code still uses long values. Tests instantiate TaskResponse with long IDs instead of UUID.
errors.fix_recommendation: Convert all long task IDs to UUID using UUID.randomUUID() or UUID.fromString() in test setup. Example: replace 'long taskId = 1L' with 'UUID taskId = UUID.randomUUID()'

errors.message: Method signature mismatch: createTask requires userId parameter (occurs 18 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask() method signature changed to require userId as first parameter, but test mocks only provide TaskCreateRequest.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all when() mock statements for createTask to include userId parameter: when(taskService.createTask(anyString(), any(TaskCreateRequest.class)))

errors.message: Method signature mismatch: getUserTasks requires 4 parameters but receives 3 (occurs 9 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() now requires userId (String), page, size, and sortBy parameters, but tests only provide userId (as long), page, and size.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add sortBy parameter to all getUserTasks calls and convert userId from long to String: taskService.getUserTasks(String.valueOf(userId), page, size,

errors.message: Method signature mismatch: bulkCreateTasks requires userId parameter (occurs 6 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.bulkCreateTasks() method signature changed to require userId as first parameter along with List<TaskCreateRequest>.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all bulkCreateTasks mock calls to include userId: when(taskService.bulkCreateTasks(anyString(), anyList()))

errors.message: Method handleValidationErrors not found in GlobalExceptionHandler (occurs 2 times)
errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler class no longer has handleValidationErrors() method, likely renamed or removed during refactoring.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check GlobalExceptionHandler for the correct method name handling MethodArgumentNotValidException. Update test to call the correct method or restore handleValidationErrors() method.

errors.message: Type mismatches in InMemoryTaskDataStore: long to String, Priority to TaskPriority (occurs 18 times)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore methods expect String userId and TaskPriority enum, but tests provide long userId and Priority enum.
errors.fix_recommendation: Convert all userId from long to String using String.valueOf() and replace Priority with TaskPriority enum in test data setup.

errors.message: Methods findAll() and existsById() not found in InMemoryTaskDataStore (occurs 3 times)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore class does not expose findAll() and existsById() methods, possibly removed or made private.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add public methods findAll() and existsById(UUID) to InMemoryTaskDataStore, or update tests to use alternative query methods like findByUserId().

summary: 8 grouped error categories found representing 100 individual compilation errors
